text.title: PR/FAQ Verdict Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing from what the review actually produced to proceed / revise / kill. Most concepts terminate in the first three branches, and that is the instrument working.

decision-tree.root-question: After two exchanges, can a customer be named specifically enough to point at a person, with their problem observed on a stated date?

conclusion.verdict: KILL at phase 1. Record verdict, rationale and killed_at_phase: 1, and write nothing else. This is the cheapest correct outcome the instrument can produce. If the concept still interests you, go diverge — a concept gate cannot manufacture a customer.

REVISE, re-enter phase 2. If the customer-facing sentence cannot be written without naming the stack or the model, you have a technology searching for a problem. One rewrite; if it fails twice, that is a kill at phase 2.

branch.when: press_release_written == true AND (cost_question_absent == true OR incumbent_unnamed == true)

conclusion.verdict: REVISE, re-enter phase 3. The two objections that decide every purchase are missing, so nothing has been tested yet. Name what it costs them and what they use today.

REVISE, re-enter phase 4. The success measure was inherited from the wrong concept type. Name the party who can kill this — the payer, the funding team, the second maintainer, the funder, the audience — and measure them.

REVISE, re-enter phase 5 after running the disproof. Do not proceed on an untested kill-assumption; run the one-week test first, then re-judge. This is the only revise that leaves the document and changes the world instead.

KILL at phase 4. An assumption that would kill the concept and cannot be cheaply falsified means the build IS the test, at build prices. Record the assumption in the rationale; it is the thing to watch for if the concept returns.
PROCEED. Write the rationale, commit the record, and only now open spec work. No score accompanies this; if someone asks for the number, the answer is the rationale.
Overlay, refuse regardless of branch. A number is negotiable by whoever wants the answer and leaves no reconstructable argument. Emit the judgement and the prose.
